business_summary: Elecom Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of personal computers and digital equipment related products in Japan and internationally. The company offers battery charger, battery; tap and power supply adapter; wireless LAN and Network ;e sports gaming connection; cable; smartphone connection; mouse key board, USB hub, input equipment; tablet PC/slate PC connection; memory; storage and NAS; optical drive; TV (on TV)-related product; video and acoustic equipment; headphones earphone headset; camera-related product; accessories; bag; outdoor connection; apple-related product; health care connection; smart watch wearable terminal; accessories for displays; pet household appliances; hygiene-related product; in-vehicle product concerned; beauty household appliances; lifestyle-related product; apple watch connection product; kitchen is cooking-related; VR-related product; security item and paper, label and printer connection; cleaning article; ink; product about electronic dictionary; and lighting equipment and LED light products. It also provides wireless LAN, network; Wi-Fi access point; Wi-Fi wireless LAN; surveillance camera, security camera for corporations; wearable camera; health care connection; digital signage; NAS; storage; security storage product; cloud application connection; the custom, PC, tablet body; Solid ZEROSHOCK tablet; security item; hygiene-related product; company disaster prevention/BCP measures product; GIGA school connection for education; battery charger and battery; tap, power, and supply adapter; mouse key, board, USB, hub, input equipment; optical drive; bags; furniture; and cleaning article products. Elecom Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
